purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official Giridih district land-records page links to JharBhoomi, and the official NIC Bhu-Naksha implementation directory links Jharkhand's cadastral viewer. The official Jharkhand GIS gateway and DILRMP report provide government context. Direct anonymous requests to JharBhoomi and JharBhuNaksha timed out before any HTML, JavaScript/configuration, API route, schema, CRS, safe parcel identity, or geometry could be obtained. No parcel sample is retained.
